title_amazon: Rowenta Handheld Steamer for Clothes, Pure Force 2in1 Steamer & Iron, 1875W, Vertical/Horizonal Steaming & Ironing, Lightweight, Auto-off, XL power, 1875 Watts, DR8822
description_amazon: With a powerful 1875 Watts and up to 90 g/min of de-wrinkling force, this clothes steamer handheld offers transitions between vertical steaming and horizontal ironing. Experience efficiency with an XL soleplate and 300% enhanced steam output for quick and effective garment care. This Rowenta steamer for clothes provides five steam settings tailored to all fabric needs and is equipped with a continuous steaming mode, becoming an ideal clothing steamer handheld solution. Not only is it lightweight for easy handling, but it's also safe and stylish, offering an 8.5-ft cord and auto-off safety features for peace of mind. The hand steamer iron for clothes' 7.1 oz tank delivers up to 12 minutes of continuous, chemical-free steam, delivering pristine fabric care every time.
top_review_amazon: I endorse this product.  I have used it for two days to iron shirts, shorts, pants and even a dish towel (for practice).  I also have a full size Rowenta Pro Style floor standing steamer and a conventional high end Rowenta iron.Compared to a conventional iron, the Pure Force hand held is much faster to use for anything with detail, such as shirts and pants. It takes me about 90 seconds to de-wrinkle a shirt with the Pure Force unit versus 5 minutes with a conventional iron.  It heats up almost instantly, so it's practical to use it for just a single garment and then put it away. The Pure Force is also easier on your clothes especially if they have delicate fabric.However, a conventional iron does leave clothes a more "pressed" look.  A conventional iron is also better if you like that creased look for your pants.I so zero advantage to the floor steamer. The hand held one is simply much better.One other comment. I saw a reviewer remark that the Pure Force is tiring to use, especially since the person reported that she had to squeeze the trigger the entire time she was steaming her laundry. This isn't true. top_review_amazon: I have always had trouble with clenching and grinding, and have gotten more help from this nightguard than from any other. I bought my second one about a month ago, after using the first one for six years. Originally, I was nervous about the negative reviews, but since my dentist had recommended it, I gave it a try. It's important to read the instructions on the package. The whole point of using this nightguard is that it trains your jaw muscles to relax in a slightly open position, training you not to clench and grind. It takes a while to get used to it, and it's important to give yourself time. The first step is to correctly adjust the bite pads for the size of your mouth (they have a couple of different adjustment settings).The first night I wore it I barely slept, worried that it was going to slip out of place and choke me or something. During the first week, it gradually got better, although a couple of times I woke up with it out of place. After that, my mouth learned to keep it in place unconsciously. It really does form to your mouth over time. It took about a month before I could close my lips and was really comfortable wearing it. It's a process, but it's totally worth it. Now I find myself grinding much less during the day, and my jaws feel better. I can even be ok skipping the nightguard for a few nights at a time. Over the six years that I had my first one, it never showed any signs of weakening or cracking. It did yellow and get a lot of hard water buildup, but that didn't seem to affect performance. However, it is not recommended to use it for six years. top_review_amazon: We try to keep the heating to a minimum - keeps the bills down, reduces our energy footprint, and just seems a good idea to not be generally wasteful, but showers and baths can get a bit chilly during the winter months.  We hate to heat up the entire house just to make the short time during bathing a bit more comfortable - one of the drawbacks of whole house central heating.  We had a small electric heater that has served this purpose for many years, but this fall, it just wouldn't heat any longer, so, we did a search for a replacement.  This is perfect!  Very simple operation - on, off, high, low, all one really needs.  It has a suitably small footprint, so that it doesn't take up a lot of floor space or get in the way of normal traffic in a small room.  I was very impressed that this company has had the wisdom to sidestep the current trend to "bedazzle" everything with expensive electronics which increase the price, provide all sorts of "features" that never get used by anybody, use energy to operate - increasing the operating costs - and ultimately fail very quickly, rendering the heater useless long before it's expected life is over.  This device does not have clocks, timers, led displays, multiple blinking colored lights, chimes, wifi connections or any of those other useless features - THANK GOODNESS!  That is why we chose this efficient, simple to operate, heater.  It DOES have a "tip over shutoff switch" which turns the heater off if it gets tipped over.  While we will probably never need it, that seems an appropriate safety feature and very necessary if you have small children or pets that might accidentally tip it over - it is quite small.  It works as described, heats the bath nicely, doesn't use a great deal of energy, it is PERFECT!

top_review_amazon: Review for: Organic Earl Grey Loose Leaf Tea 16oz bag (1pound), bought  September 2020.The underlying black tea is a good mix of Keemun and Assam. The Keemun makes for a lighter tea that does not drown out the Bergamotte oil, or force an amount that makes the tea taste soapy. Twinings itself has replaced most of the real Bergamotte oil with extract and their website doesn't say how much real Bergamotte is left. I still like Twinings Earl Grey, it's been my family tea for more than half a century, but knowing that this organic product uses only the real thing (2% organic Bergamotte content, as per ingredient list) is an extra star in my book. The tea that arrived was super fresh with an aromatic scent (expiry date end of January 2023), which is important as the bergamotte oil fragrance and tea aroma will evaporate over time.The taste is a delicious, light to medium strength Earl Grey, great on its own or (for lighter taste) mixed with 1/3rd Darjeeling. If you are used to soapily strong Earl Grey variants or those made with Assam alone, you may find it too light. If you like Twinings, you'll probably like it alot.I have not been able to do a direct taste comparison side by side, as I ran out of Twinings before this arrived, but as I am sitting here, sipping a cup of the hot, dark-golden liquid with a small teaspoon of cane sugar, tasting a well balanced mix of light black tea and bergamotte oil, I am letting out a satisfied sigh. I am finding  this one to be an excellent substitute.Update 2021: Had 3 1-pound-bags of this in the meantime, and all of them were perfectly aromatic and tasty.Preparation instructions:Serve in thin-lipped bone-china cups of approx. 6oz size (better sensory experience than mugs for delicate teas, see image).Use 2 tea pots and a straining sieve: one pot to steep the leaves and another to strain the brewed tea into, in order to get the leaves out before they turn bitter.Bring 3 cups / 24 oz of water to boil, pour over 6g (0.22oz) Earl Grey tea leaves while still boiling. The leaves should float freely in a pre-warmed tea pot. For less or more tea, just multiply or divide water and tea by the same amounts.Strain after no longer than 3 minutes of steeping through a tea-straining sieve into the serving tea pot. (I am setting a timer to 2:40 min brewing time and don't stress over 20 seconds more). When I strain the tea, I either stirr the leaves right before, or let the leaves drip from the sieve after straining, to get all the full, concentrated tea. (if you accidentally steeped it too long, you can try decanting without stirring the leaves and it might save you from a bitter experience). I drink it with a little cane sugar and a piece of bread with something sweet on it, and thereafter, my brain starts working. If you are a Trekkie and have not tried what Picard's favorite drink really is about when properly prepared, this is it. If yours is bitter, you either use too much tea or you let it steep too long.Oh, and I never use tea bags for black tea. It is filled with the tea dust that is breaking off from the properly dried tea leaves, the leftover after the leaves have been packaged. That tends to make for an overpoweringly strong tea, plus the dust tends to seep into the tea itself. Either that or (with luxury versions=filled with proper leaves) it does not have enough room for giving off its taste. Free floating is the way to go.If you want to avoid the garbage getting all wet, just leave the used leaves to drip and dry in the sieve over the pot you used for  steeping before throwing them away.Disclaimer: this is the first time ever I bought this product. I have picked and paid it myself and have nothing whatsoever to do with either FGO, Amazon or Twinings. This is a pure tea enthusiast's review article and I hope you enjoyed it and your tea.

top_review_amazon: UPDATE 6/1/24: I decided to update the review after a couple months of use- because I feel that’s fair. I did end up purchasing a second set in the bright white. These sheets wash really well, dry quickly on the low dryer setting, and they DO get softer after each wash! There’s no pilling, and I’ve not had to worry about whether they will rip or tear. It seems that they will last quite a long time.  I am completely happy with my purchase! I’ll purchase them for as long as they continue to make and carry them!After eyeballing these sheets and the reviews for a while, they went on sale-further reduced from an already low price (we all know how expensive sheets can be). My thought process was of these sheets didn’t work out, I didn’t spend that much and it wouldn’t be a huge loss. Boy, was I pleasantly surprised! It took a bit to receive them, but they showed up yesterday and I immediately put them in the wash, and dried on low as instructed. They didn’t take too long to dry- and naturally, 100% cotton is going to be a little more wrinkly than others. That doesn’t bother me. I put these sheets on straight out of the dryer. I had zero issues with the fitted sheet fitting my mattress. The top sheet is not as wide as I’m used to, but it’s large enough.Now, the real test! We slept on them last night. They are so soft! Now, if you’re used to the sateen feel- this is going to be a little different. I’ve had all sheet ranges in the past from 1000 thread count, to 200 thread count. I sleep warm, so I need sheets that breathe and can’t use the 1000 thread counts. These sheets fit the bill perfectly! I felt like they are breathable, and I didn’t sweat. I was so cozy. In fact, I woke up a few times in the middle of the night just to move around in bed and relish in the coziness. They honestly feel like the sheets we’ve slept in at the Four Seasons hotel. Are they super thick? No. But I dislike thick sheets. They seem very well made and I have no concerns that they are going to last. Others have mentioned that they further soften with each wash. I’m looking forward to that and truly considering purchasing more and throwing away all of my old sets. I purchased the bright white, so I’ve had no issues with color as others have. They are truly bright white. I regret not purchasing these sooner!

top_review_amazon: The “specialty” button on this model makes a better cup of coffee than my pour over method, not exaggerating, which I’ve done for years. Read on for tips.I first bought the Ninja model without the  “specialty” button at the store- and then got on amazon and realized that the store didnt even have this model. So I returned that and ordered this.While the specialty option does not taste just like an espresso, that’s fine with me because the flavor is fantastic (Gevalia Colombia!) and honestly I don’t like how compact and thick espresso tastes, to drink every morning anyway. (I returned a Nespresso before buying this. Not for me). I use just 2 “big scoops” instead of the 4 recommended by Ninja, and it is the tastiest coffee, rivaling fresh ground bean pour overs and beating most, which is a shock to me. I think if you used the 4 “big scoop” recipe it would work well for drinks with milk. I don’t drink milk in coffee but can imagine double the strength working fine for that purpose.I no longer have time in the morning for pour overs, unfortunately, but this machine is really making it easy on me! I am in love with just touching a button and walking away- and getting better tasting coffee! It “blooms” the grinds and has a showerhead water dispenser, so it might just work better than a pour over, in terms of consistency. This recipe is strong, though, so I often clean out the filter and just hit the “classic” button again, into a clean glass, and use most of that water to dilute my drink. The idea is that coffee is simply less bitter the less time water is running over it. So brewing a lower yield cup for shorter time, and then adding clean hot water to taste, really does rival a pour over.  I do this even for a half carafe- just select a lower yield option (see the quick guide) checking that the brew coming out never becomes that pale brown color (that’s the bitter part). Just always clean out the used grinds to get some clean water. You have to play with the preset output options and amount of coffee to make a larger quantity this way. But it’s way less time to do than standing over the grinds and pouring yourself.My main concern is heating water inside plastic, which is why I started using the pour over method. I wish Ninja would make it BPA free and label it as such, as some other brands do. I was not able to find a machine without plastic, and the BPA free brands had some bad reviews about performance, which I don’t have time for. So Ninja, if you’re reading, please make your coffee makers BPA free as I know lots of people won’t use coffee makers due to the plastic. I just have been forced into using a machine, so, taking my chances but really enjoying the coffee.If you are looking at other Ninja models, or other single serve option coffee makers, this guy has it all and performs very well. You can go from a single morning cup to making a full pot, and all the milk drinks. It does it all. I read so many reviews and they are right. This is a great machine.I store the water tank in the fridge when Im done to prevent mold growth. There is definitely water inside the machine after a brew (same as any model) so dont let this sit unused and definitely run the cleaning cycles as recommended. I will be keeping my eye on where the water goes in.But the removable tank is easy to pop in the fridge. I really like that.Ok! Please click helpful if this helped you! I am late to work now but wanted to help you out! Have a good one and hope you buy this guy! :)

The next issue is the way the mesh cooking rack contacts the pan when you're air frying anything and using the pan as means of catching the drippings. I love how the internal light is clear and bright, and automatically comes on when there's a little time left on the timer so you can have a peek and see if it's already done. The digital display is neat/modern looking and very nice to use. Oh, and I should mention that I really like the way it makes toast! I didn't think I'd see any difference there, but weirdly enough I do.

top_review_amazon: I've been using the Elite Gourmet EHC4128 Coffee Maker for about a month now, and I have to say — I'm genuinely impressed. It's a simple machine, nothing fancy, but it does one thing really well: makes a consistently good cup of coffee.As someone who grew up on strong, aromatic South Indian filter coffee (the kind brewed slowly in a metal filter with chicory-blended coffee powder), I've always been a bit picky about my morning brew. I wasn't expecting this little coffee maker to match that experience - but to my surprise, it comes really close.It's super easy to use — just add water, scoop in your coffee, and press a button. I've been using my usual filter coffee powder, and the flavor is bold, smooth, and rich. I make it a bit stronger, then mix it with hot milk and sugar — and honestly, the first sip took me straight back to mornings at home in Chennai. & The reusable filter is a nice touch - no need to fuss with paper filters every day. The warming plate keeps the coffee hot without making it bitter, and cleanup is quick. It's compact too, which is great for smaller kitchens or apartments.If you're someone who enjoys South Indian coffee but doesn't always have time for the traditional method, this coffee maker is a lifesaver. It's not trying to be high-end or high-tech — it just works, and works really well.Totally worth it. Highly recommend!

description_amazon: About this item DOG WHITENING SHAMPOO – Chris Christensen White on White Dog Shampoo gets the yellow out! This product is an optic intensifying treatment within a shampoo, removing all yellow stains, and will also enhance darker colors, leaving a luscious sheen. It brightens and whitens the coat while maintaining the coat’s texture. The result is a stain-free, brilliant, dazzling coat that’s soft to the touch. Available in two sizes; 16 fl. oz for at-home use and a gallon for professional use. PERFECT FOR PUPPIES – use from 8-weeks upwards. Chris Christensen’s Whitening Shampoo for dogs is ideal for removing urine stains from potty training, marks from doggy daycare, and dirt from the dog park. Using White on White neutralizes unwanted stains that cleansing does not remove such as grass, saliva, clay, food, and blood. SAFE TO USE – White on White Shampoo does not contain bleaching agents, harsh chemicals, or softening agents to irritate you or your pup’s skin, and while a purple shampoo in color it will not stain hands, towels, or tubs. For best results, follow with Chris Christensen After U Bathe to rinse out any shampoo residue, condition the coat, and add moisture. White on White Shampoo lasts up to 4 weeks and will not rub off on hands, clothing, or furniture. A strand test is recommended on porous coats. ENHANCE COLORED COATS – not just for white dogs! Chris Christensen White on White Shampoo can be used on mixed coat colors. Blacks, browns, and reds will be enhanced, adding vibrancy and sheen. Perfect for Border Collies, Rough Collies, Beagles, Cavalier King Charles Spaniels, and more, along with any white-only breeds such as Maltese, Bichon Frise, Samoyeds etc. BEST IN SHOW RESULTS – made in the USA. White on White is the first ‘true’ coloring correcting shampoo created initially for show dogs by Chris Christensen in 1996. Regarded highly in and out of the show ring, Chris Christensen dog grooming products have a reputation for performance and perfection. Trusted by professional groomers, show exhibitors, and caring dog owners. › See more product details

My dog's coat looks not only brighter but also incredibly soft and shiny. The formula is gentle yet effective, and it doesn't strip the coat of its natural oils, which is important for maintaining healthy skin.One of the best things about this shampoo is that it's free of harsh bleaching agents. However, it's important to follow the directions and let it sit on the coat for a few minutes to get the Best results.

As we age, our skin changes and begins to have different needs, and this fragile skin moisturizing formula from DerMend was specially developed to meet them. Many factors, including the general aging process, repeated sun exposure or damage, genetics, and diet or medications, cause elastin and collagen under the skin’s surface to break down. DerMend fragile skin cream provides targeted care to help protect and strengthen mature skin.

LOOK MORE YOUTHFUL
DerMend’s fragile skin moisturizing formula not only softens and nourishes dry skin, it helps tighten sagging, wrinkled skin that’s lost its elasticity over time. Maintain a more youthful appearance while you strengthen and care for thin, vulnerable skin.

DERMATOLOGIST RECOMMENDED
This dermatologist recommended formula moisturizes, repairs and replenishes the thinning skin on your face and body. Apply regularly to improve your skin health and appearance. Skin that can properly repair and protect itself will lead to less tearing, bruising and bleeding.

NOURISHING FORMULA
Rejuvenating ingredients and enriching moisturizes combine to make this cream highly effective. Retinol, a form of Vitamin A, helps renew the appearance of skin, while hyaluronic acid helps skin retain moisture and its resilience as you age. The cream also contains glycolic acid for gentle exfoliation, antioxidant-rich niacinamide and ceramides, a type of lipid which plays an important role in our skin’s aging and ability to hold moisture.

USE TWICE DAILY
For best results, apply DerMend Mature Skin Solutions cream morning and night or as directed by your physician to help rejuvenate and restore fragile skin

top_review_amazon: I love this product!As a long time breeze box user I have tried many different options for cat pads. For me these are the best. I purchased some *brand name* when I ran out of  these and I was unhappy with the result of that product and put these on subscription. The brand pads are still in my garage for emergency back up.* Ingredients and thickness I feel that the ingredients of the pad  are just right, the urine gels or absorbs I can pick up the pad without fear of spillage. Other than that I can’t complain about this product at all.**General things have found that make a differnce with this system.* I use “Press and  Seal” to line the tray I find that it keeps the tray from absorbing urine odor since the company doesn’t sell replacement  parts. I change this once a month.* I use an extra large charcoal doggy pad cut in quarters under my pee pad for just in case to keep  urine from absorbing in to the plastic tray.I have only had Amazon pads leak a few times and I’m sure it’s been because of my failure to stay on top of changing my pads and to be honest when I had 2 cats using the box I would have to change pads every 3-4 days  but I still feel these pads held up as well or better than brand name pads. I will forever be a loyal user of these. Just with they had better odor control but I understand not everyone would be a fan of added chemicals.

top_review_amazon: OMG but this is an awesome hose!! I decided to buy because I'm disabled and I liked that it was light weight and small via the ad and some reviews. I've got a tree I'm trying to save that is water stressed meaning it's not been water except for rain. It came with a little on/off connector which I love and comes in handy so water isn't being wasted. What I didn't understand was when I was done and shut the water spigot off~the hose was not shrinking back to small! Then I realized that I had to drain the water from the hose! Turned the on lever and as soon as water started draining out the hose started shrinking!! Bam, right back to it's original small size! LOVE IT! Super light weight; I can carry the hose, a coffee, and phone in 1 hand with my cane in other. I've not had long so don't know about the durability yet but its very flexible. It doesn't kink due to the material its covered in but I did notice when it curls the water pressure went down a little; I just had to straighten the hose for pressure to be full again. I definitely recommend~especially to anyone whose disabled. Its the lightest, smallest hose I've ever had and it is such a huge upgrade from those cruddy old kinds of hoses!!

description_amazon: In 1977, Gillette introduced the Atra razor system, the first twin-blade shaving cartridge with a pivoting head, which allows the blades to better follow the contours of the face for a closer shave. The Atra PLUS was launched in 1985 which was the first razor to add a lubricating strip. Still popular today, get the close shave you've always wanted with these Gillette Atra Plus razor blade refills. These blade refills feature a lubrastrip for smoothness and comfort, and two pivoting twin blades that keep both blades on your beard for closeness. The easy loading system makes changing razor blades fast, and cleaning it is even easier, making this perfect for use on your face and neck. For an even better shave, use with your favorite Gillette shave gel, cream or foam. Each pack of Gillette Atra Plus refills comes with 10 blade refills. These refills fit any Gillette Atra razor handle.

top_review_amazon: I've been a loyal user of Gillette razors for years, but the Gillette SkinGuard Men's Razor Blades have truly raised the bar, earning a solid 5-star review from me. With the latest 8 blade refill pack, I am reminded of why I chose Gillette in the first place – quality and innovation for a comfortable shave.The standout feature of the SkinGuard blades is their unique design aimed at minimizing skin irritation. As someone with sensitive skin prone to razor bumps and ingrown hairs, I've often struggled with finding a razor that doesn't leave my skin red and inflamed. Since making the switch to SkinGuard, I've noticed a significant reduction in these issues. The blades glide across the skin with such ease, cutting hairs efficiently without the tug and pull that can lead to irritation.One of the best aspects of these blades is their longevity. Each refill lasts me several weeks, maintaining sharpness and effectiveness throughout. This is a testament to the durability and high-quality materials Gillette has always been known for. Despite daily use, the blades do not dull quickly, ensuring that each shave is as comfortable as the last.Additionally, the precision trimmer on the back is excellent for edging and styling, making it a versatile tool for my grooming routine. It’s great for getting those tricky spots and styling sideburns or facial hair with precision and control.The value pack of 8 refills is also economical, providing a long-lasting supply that saves me the hassle of frequent repurchases. It also speaks to the confidence Gillette has in their product – they’re not just selling you a single shave; they’re offering a solution that will keep you satisfied for months to come.In terms of compatibility, these blades fit perfectly with the SkinGuard handles, and they are compatible with my existing Gillette handle, making it convenient for me to switch to these skin-friendly blades without additional investment.In summary, the Gillette SkinGuard Men's Razor Blades with the 8 Blade Refills pack is an excellent investment for anyone seeking a close, comfortable, and irritation-free shave. It’s particularly suited for men with sensitive skin, but I’d recommend it to anyone who wants a premium shave experience. Thanks to Gillette, my morning routine is now a smoother, more comfortable experience.

top_review_amazon: Overall I'd give this litter 4.5 stars. On the positive sides:-It is very low dust. There is some, but, not nearly as much as clay litters. It's slightly more than the grass seed litter I'd been using.-It is extremely lightweight compared to all other litters I've tried.-Has a light, pleasant woodsy, almost sweet smell.-Does a great job with odor control for a natural litter. Could add some baking soda if you wanted to, but, I haven't tried with this litter as I haven't felt it's needed.There are a couple minor issues I do have with the litter:-Because it is so lightweight, it tracks EVERYWHERE.  Now, I knew this would be the case, and my cat likes to dig just to dig so I'm not taking anything off for this, just posting for awareness.-Clumping is mediocre on this. It is super absorbent, and it does clump very quickly, but, those clumps don't hold together all that well. They tend to break into chunks 3/8 of an inch or so. This is whereI'd  remove 1/2 star if I could. Makes cleaning the box more tedious.Overall, however, I'm happy to have found a replacement litter for the grass seed I'd been getting as it's gone up about 40% in price. I have tried several other brands and while they all did a decent job, they all had drawbacks that didn't justify switching. This litter seems to do well enough that I'm comfortable switching.

top_review_amazon: This bundle is a great deal! I am very fair and I do not like to sit in the sun. I first tried the dark to deep hoping to accelerate color. My color came out nice, but a little orangish. A little tanning smell when applying, but NOTHING the next day and nothing after showering. I then tried the light version and wow! I met my tanning soulmate. The color came out a very pretty light brownish, with a subtle glow.This also stays nicely for 2 showers and then I needed to apply again. This is a white lotion, so no color guide BUT this tanner is very hard to get wrong. I use a 2 tanning mits and a tanning back wiper and this lotion is so forgiveable my color comes out nicely- not streaky at all. When I used the deeper shade, I could tell where I applied a little too much, much it was easy to fix with some glycolic acid on a cotton pad.Also, during the summer I do not use any moisturizers or soaps with acids (lactic, aha, bha, glycolic, azealic etc.) because they will exfoliate your tan off- BUT if you make a boo-boo you can use them to buff down an over zealous patch. I use perlier honey gel and philosophy pure grace in the shower, and for lotion I use perlier honey or philosophy pure grace. Then I follow this with Vaseline bronze shine on my décolleté , legs and arms for a mature glowy touch - it looks great!  Not like I fell into sparkles…Anyway, pick the color that best fits where you are now. I am glad I took a step down from the deep to the light . My faux tan came out much more realistic. This is also very hard to ‘mess up’ compared to stronger tanners like st tropez. I do use the st tropez 1 hr express occasionally on top of the jergens for a little oomph and it comes out really pretty—— especially when I follow it up with the Vaseline bronze glowing lotion!

top_review_amazon: I am interested in sugar substitutes, not because I am diabetic but to cut down on calories.I am on a strict healthy diet to keep a lower weight and I make efforts to get as much nutrition as possible while also enjoying my food.I have been trying to cut out the 120 calories of tablespoons of raw unfiltered honey or unrefined cane sugar from my morning vegan milkshake. Yes, these are good sweeteners but they still have calories.Pure stevia extract worked terribly as a substitute in my milkshake; I could never ignore the bitter aftertaste (the one place stevia has worked amazingly for me so far is lemonade). I couldn’t even handle pure monkfruit extract in my milkshake. I also used sucralose liquid from another company in my milkshake and it was too bitter. This Splenda helped me finally succeed in cutting out the 120 calories.Here is my recipe!1. 2 cups of Eden Foods soy milk (the version with just soybeans and water)2. Two tablespoons of raw pure cocoa powder (I use the Terrasoul brand)3. Two tablespoons of pure oil-free salt-free sugar-free sunflower butter (just sunflower butter). I use the Sunbutter brand.4. Three packets of Splenda (equivalent to the two tablespoons of sweetener I was using previously).The result is very pleasant and very satisfying. Probably the versions with added-calorie sweeteners were tastier (I love the taste of unfiltered raw honey and raw unrefined cane sugar), but this more than does the job and I am saving on 120 calories. No after taste at all. I am very satisfied with my yummy Splenda sweetened morning chocolate drink.I plan to use Splenda in healthy homemade ice creams as well. Not sure if it’s safety at high temperatures for baking though.I also know that people say Splenda can affect gut microbiomes, but I do take a probiotic supplement daily.For the record, I have not craved store brought sweet desserts since making my nutritionally dense yummy versions at home. I now have store brought desserts or eat out only one or two times a month at the most and even then am often dissatisfied with the tastes of food 😀.Being thin while strictly eating the most nutritionally dense food possible has been a fun exploratory journey.For the record, I am not a strict vegan as I found salmon with bones and skin provides me a lot of nutritional value. Apart from that though, most days I avoid other animal foods besides honey.

top_review_amazon: I’ve tried just about every zero sugar soda out there, and Dr Pepper Zero Sugar is easily one of the best. It somehow manages to capture that classic Dr Pepper flavor — the 23 mysterious flavors — without tasting like a diet soda. There's no weird aftertaste, no chemical bite, just smooth, full-bodied flavor that hits all the right notes.What I really appreciate is that it's not overly sweet or watery like some other sugar-free sodas. It feels satisfying and refreshing, especially ice cold. The 12 oz cans are perfect for keeping in the fridge or grabbing on the go, and the 12-pack is a good value compared to buying singles.If you’re looking to cut back on sugar but don’t want to sacrifice taste, this is a must-try. top_review_amazon: I ordered these shelves to display my figures and dolls, and I love the way they look! I ordered 2 sets of the 4 pack in black with black hardware. After looking at reviews, I took the jump and bought them and don't regret it!TL;DR: Listing is accurate, don't use the paper measurement thingy, quality is what you'd expect for the price, doesn't come pre-drilled, easy enough to put together, over all worth it if you're looking for smaller, decent quality, decent price shelves especially if you display figures or dolls.1. Listing: They are accurate to the measurements! They're only 5.5 inches deep, so there isn't much (if at all) any room for layering. They do feel small, but the listing is accurate!! Mine are paired next to each other to create a "longer" shelf. DO NOT use the paper measurement thingy. Another review mentioned it was un-even, and after holding it to mine, yeah, it was off. I'd highly recommend a stud finder, small leveler, and a white gel pen or marker to mark where to drill if you do.2. Assembling & Mounting: The shelves didn't come with pre-drilled holes for the mounting options because it was easy enough to screw into. I will warn you that the small screws only came with a singular extra, so be careful about losing them in case it's the same for you... I'd highly recommend doing this on a FLAT surface. I stood the shelves on the side that would be flat against the wall and set the brackets against it. I put one screw in on each side (both brackets have 1 screw to hold them where I want) then I laid it on its top and tightened and added the other screw. I may have done more work than needed, but none of mine are leaning forward or backward super far. I used the "load bearing" mount simply because I like the look but if you intend to put books, I would do the "no drop" design and possibly get some other L brackets for more support since books can get heavy. PLAN WHERE YOU WANT THE BRACKETS if you intend on doing the "load bearing" design or adding any more brackets.4. Quality: I kind of expected the wood to be a bit thicker/more sturdy feeling, but upon realizing they didn't come pre-drilled, it made more sense. THEY CHIP AND SCRATCH EASILY. If you're like me and don't really care as long as you cant see/don't notice it, then this isn't any concern but they may come damaged cause some of our mail couriers aren't the best. If you stick them in the corner like I did, please be careful about it slipping! I accidentally dropped the second one from a 21-inch TV stand after adding brackets, and the corner chipped (yes, I measured). The hardware is standard screw quality, and the brackets could be better. After reading the broken bracket reviews plus the price, I honestly wasn't expecting much, but they aren't too bad! You can always replace them with another one you like!5. Overall: I'd say these are worth the price and I see why "customers usually keep this item"! They were easy enough to mount, even if you aren't the handiest man out there. I'd definitely recommend these if you're looking to display anime figures or dolls like I do! They're nice for adding vertical space without sticking out of the wall too much! Definitely good for smaller spaces! I'm very happy with this product and will more than likely return to this listing if I want some decent and affordable shelving!Thank you for reading my review, Im usually hesitant to buy online so I hope it helps you decide if you wanna buy these shelves as well!(Also, in case anyone is wondering the layout, the longest shelf will be 1, the middle length will be 2, the shortest length will be 3. It's the last image of the review!)

title_amazon: Kwikset Casey Interior Privacy Door Handle with Lock, Door Lever For Bathroom and Bedroom, Matte Black Reversible Keyless Turn Lock, with Microban Protection
description_amazon: As the industry leader, Kwikset has provided trusted security for over 70 years and has become synonymous with security, peace of mind, style and innovation. The Casey Lever combines the strength and durability of a Kwikset product in stylish & contemporary design. The contours of the lever makes it feel comfortable without sacrificing features. Available with Smartkey Security and Microban on select finishes. This privacy knob/lever is best used in interior bedroom and bathroom applications where privacy is required. Both knobs/levers are operated by the thumb turn on the inside. The outside knob/lever is unlocked by an emergency key. The rich tones of Matte Black add the finishing touch to this product. The Matte Black finish provides a rich and warm complement to the product’s style.
top_review_amazon: Stylish, Secure, and Super Easy to InstallI recently upgraded the front door handle to this Kwikset Casey model, and I’m really happy with the quality and design. The matte black finish looks sleek and modern — it instantly gave my front door a more upscale appearance.Installation was simple, even for someone who isn’t super handy. Everything lined up perfectly, and the instructions were clear. The lever is reversible, which was great since my door opens the opposite way most do.The SmartKey feature is a huge plus — I was able to rekey it myself in just a minute without needing a locksmith. That alone makes this worth the price. It also feels solid and secure when locking/unlocking — not flimsy like cheaper models I’ve used in the past.Bonus points for the Microban protection — nice to know it has built-in germ resistance, especially for a high-touch item like this.Overall, a great value, secure and stylish door handle that I’d recommend for any entryway or bedroom.

Cornhole Bags Built to Last

Play Platoon's heavy-duty cornhole bags are newly designed and built to last. High-quality stitching and strong material ensure these bags won't burst open when thrown. Plus, they're filled with sand so they can handle all weather, even rain.

Includes Carry Bag

The Play Platoon Cornhole Bag set comes with a complimentary mesh carry bag for bringing your regulation size cornhole bean bags to and from parties. Plus, it's a great way to store the corn bags and keep them all together.

How to Play

Cornhole toss can be a 2 or 4 player game. The corn hole boards are set up 27 feet across from each other. Each team stands behind the front edge of their side's board and tosses their cornhole bean bags at the other side's board.

The first one team will throw a bag, then the other, switching back and forth until all 8 stars and stripes cornhole bags have been thrown. A bag that lands on the board are worth 1 point. A bag that goes into the hole is worth 3. Any bags that touch the ground, including bags that hit the ground first then bounce onto the board, are worth 0 points.

The winner of the previous round tosses first in the next round. The first team to reach 21 points wins.

We know you'll love Play Platoon Weather Resistant Cornhole Bags. Order today and start playing with your friends!

top_review_amazon: These cherry tomatoes are some of the best I've ever eaten, and that includes the dozens of tomato varieties I've grown at home over the last 20 years. I'm a devoted Sungold lover, but for a true red cherry tomato flavor (instead of the fruitiness of a Sungold), these are king. They're about an inch long, oblong/grape tomato shaped, and although the skins are a bit on the thicker side, the sweet, juicy, fleshy interior more than makes up for that.They're great for eating out of hand as a snack, and also incredible sliced in half and used in salads, on toast, served with mozzarella and olive oil, mixed together with cucumbers, etc., etc. I haven't tried cooking with them yet, but since I'm not the biggest fan of cooked tomatoes, I'm happy to continue eating them raw in dozens of ways. I loved them so much that after buying my first container, I immediately turned around and bought 3 more. After sharing them with a relative, they liked them so much that I had to send them home with a container. And since they're not crazy expensive for a box, I'm happy to do that.Now, I would caution you against buying these from Amazon, only because out of the 4 boxes I bought, 2 of them had several dried, wrinkly-looking tomatoes, and started to grow mold within a day of receipt. That just shouldn't happen. Thankfully, Amazon refunded me for the 2 boxes that weren't so fresh, but if you have these available from a grocery store nearby or somewhere where you can actually check the freshness first, it'd probably be a safer bet to get them elsewhere.My other favorite store-bought tomato are Kumatos and these truly rival those, being even sweeter and more portable, but they're a bit less complex in flavor (black tomatoes tend to have a really unique flavor profile that I enjoy a lot). I'll definitely still buy Kumatos, but I'm happy to be able to add another delicious tomato to my culinary repertoire.

The power line rate is mainly decided by the quality of power line environment it’s operating in. When your power line rate is low, you may try the steps below to improve the quality of service.Step 1:Please check whether your powerline adapters are plugged directly into a wall outlet. If not, please move the adapters to an outlet on the wall.Step 2:Please check if there are electrical devices, which have a motor inside them, around the powerline adapters. Such equipment can be air-conditioners, washing-machines, electric-fans etc.. Please move such equipment to another location if possible, or move powerline adapters away from such equipment. You may also buy a surge protector and plug such equipments to its outlets to avoid any interference they may cause.Step 3:Please check if there are AC power adapters, such as those used for mobile phones, laptops or something else around the adapters. If the quality of AC power adapter is not good, it may cause noise on the power line circuit. Please move it to another place away from the powerline adapters.Step 4:Please check if the distance between the adapters is too long. In theory, the maximum distance is 300 meters. However, with interference and line quality, it will be hard to reach the full 300 meters.

Thanks to heirlooms, Pipcorn has more nutrition than commercially grown popcorn, including fiber, antioxidants, and vitamins. SUSTAINABLE Growing heirlooms helps protect the genetic diversity of our food supply because they are open-pollinated. Each generation of heirloom seeds come from a random set of parents, leading to a stronger genetic line. Plus, growing heirlooms helps to preserve agricultural biodiversity by championing unique varieties that might otherwise be lost. HISTORICAL TRADITION Pipcorn is both a connection to the past, and an investment in a sustainable future. With each harvest, we save seeds to plant the next time around. Effective and Quick - Tratper is designed with a responsive lock chamber, a sensitive trigger pad, and a specially designed jaw with teeth to ensure mice or rats won’t escape. The easy-to-clean material and lever mouth allow for simple discarding and washing to be reused. Handle with gloves for higher capture rate. top_review_amazon: I’ve had a rat problem here in San Diego for the past several months. It’s one thing when they’re in the yard, but it’s a whole another thing when they’re start getting into my car and leaving urine and feces on the engine cover. Next will be damage to the hoses which I do not need on any level.I purchased these rat traps as a pack of 4 and put 2 out at a time. They’re incredibly easily to use. Unscrew the bottom cork, pop some peanut butter in it, screw it back in, and simply pull the lid closed which is where the trap is activated. I set them along my fence where the rats like to run, and within 24 hours I caught 2. Set up the next two traps two days later, and I got the same exact result. When properly set up, these things make the death instead and humane which matters to me because I do love animals. I don’t want them to suffer. I couldn’t recommend these traps more as they are very safe against other animals getting into them, there’s no need to poison them which would affect other predators if they ate the poisoned rat, and they’re super easy to use.Good luck with your rodent problem.

description_amazon: Product Description Justin's Nut Butters are made by using a one-of-a-kind grinding process that merges high-quality, naturally delicious ingredients with amazing taste, texture and nutrition. From the Manufacturer Justin's Products Our products are made with common sense and the highest quality. We think that selectively choosing fine, naturally delicious ingredients creates better tasting products. And we are certain your tastebuds will agree. Enjoy our naturally delicious, high-quality nut butters, nut butter snacks and organic peanut butter cups for their great taste, unique texture and convenient nutrition. Nuts for Sustainability At Justin’s, we strive to make more than delicious products; we hope to make a difference. To name just a few initiatives: Mindfully Sourced Ingredients, Pollinator Conservation, Hunger Relief Support, Organic and Rainforest Alliance Certified Cocoa...and many more! As we grow, so does our ability to give back. Join us. One-of-a-Kind Grind It all started with a jar. With the help of a simple food processor and the highest quality ingredients available, Justin revolutionized the world of nut butter to create products driven by a passion for delicious taste, unique texture and quality ingredients. First, he created them for his adventures. Now, he makes them for you. First Ever Nut Butter Squeeze Pack As the first nut butter brand to market protein-packed nut butters in single-serve squeeze packs, Justin’s provides a convenient source of nutrition for an active lifestyle. Available in 7 varieties, squeeze packs are perfect to enjoy on toast, fruit or right out of the pack. So, give your favorite nut butter a squeeze anytime, anywhere and on anything. Peanut Butter Cup Perfection What’s more perfect than peanut butter and chocolate? By blending his artisanal peanut butter with high quality chocolate, Justin created a better-for-you alternative to the conventional peanut butter cup. 100% organic, Rainforest Alliance-certified, gluten free and delicious. Yup, it’s how a peanut butter cup should taste. Available in dark, milk, or white chocolate, and miniature-sized if you're adventurous. #fueledbyjustins The story began in 2004 when Justin Gold, a lover of the active lifestyle, moved to Boulder, Colorado in his 20’s. In order to fuel his long bike rides, Justin embarked on a mission to create new varieties of nut butter that not only packed the protein, but also tasted great. He began crafting the very first batches of his now-famous, culinary nut butters in his home kitchen. About the Company Describe your product in 3 words.Nuts. Fuel. Delicious.How did you come up with the idea for this product?Given that nut butter was a staple in my vegetarian diet, plain old peanut butter just wasn’t cutting it. I started grinding my own flavors and an assortment of experimental nut butters began to fill the cabinets. After weeks of hungry roommates stealing my tasty creations, I wrote my name on the jar and Justin's was born.What makes your product special?When I first started making nut butter, I didn’t overthink whether it was “smooth” or “crunchy”, I just made it because it tasted good, that is made with common sense ingredients and fills a lifestyle need. That’s what I continue to do today, focus on making naturally delicious products. It’s simple really. Simple, and delicious.What has been the best part of your startup experience?It’s the creative and collaborative aspect of innovating that makes every day exciting. And, as we grow, we continue to invest in our commitment to corporate consciousness. We have the opportunity to truly be visionaries and develop great tasting products that people love.

description_amazon: About this item Hoosier Hill Farm Big Daddy Mac Mix is the secret ingredient to easy and delicious mac and cheese every time! Big Daddy Mac is the original macaroni and cheese sauce mix, and it makes a great-tasting macaroni and cheese that everyone will enjoy. Simply prepare your favorite noodles, drain, and add in your milk of choice plus butter or margarine and Big Daddy Mac, and voila! Description: Revitalize your pool and eliminate stubborn algae with our Calcium Hypochlorite Pool Shock. This potent formula is specifically designed for rapid and effective algae control, ensuring a clear and inviting swimming environment. Ideal for periodic treatments, this product is a powerful solution to combat algae infestations and maintain pristine pool water.

Key Features:

  • Algae Control: Robust calcium hypochlorite formula swiftly tackles algae blooms, restoring water clarity.
  • Fast-Acting: Rapid dissolving granules for quick and efficient shock treatment.
  • Multi-Purpose: Suitable for various pool types, including in-ground and above-ground pools.
  • Shock Treatment: Perfect for periodic shock treatments to address algae outbreaks and boost overall water sanitation.
  • Convenient Packaging: Available in user-friendly packaging for easy dosage and application.
  • Proven Effectiveness: Professional-grade formula trusted by pool maintenance experts.
  • Versatile Application: Can be used to raise chlorine levels, eliminate contaminants, and break down chloramines.

Directions for Use:

  1. Measure the pool's water volume to determine the required amount of product.
  2. Add the recommended dosage directly to the pool water, distributing it evenly across the surface.
  3. Run the pool pump for several hours to ensure proper circulation and distribution of the shock treatment.
  4. Avoid swimming until chlorine levels return to the recommended range as indicated by a water testing kit.
  5. For severe algae infestations, consider repeating the shock treatment after 24 hours.

Caution:

  • Keep out of reach of children.
  • Avoid direct contact with skin and eyes.
  • Use in a well-ventilated area.
  • Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight.
  • Follow all safety and usage instructions provided by the manufacturer.

Note: Regular testing of pool water and maintenance of proper pH levels are essential for optimal shock treatment results.

Our 65% Calcium Hypochlorite granules are perfect for immediate & dramatic results when you need to clean & clear the cloudy water in your pool, spa, and hot tub.

  • US EPA Registered - Filed & Approved Biocide
  • UN2880 Calcium Hypochlorite Hydrated 5.1 PG II
  • CAS Number: 7778-54-3 (Calcium Hypochlorite)

top_review_amazon: These, work perfectly if you remember to do a few simple things:1. Wrap moist food lightly in plastic wrap, cling wrap or press N seal. If freezing, freeze liquids like sauces in flat containers (like lock n lock), remove when frozen and wrap, or place into a regular zip bag with the zipper cut off, then put into the foodsaver bag. This enables you to reuse the foodsaver bag later.2. Press some of the air out of the bag. Press the zip strip firmly on a hard surface two or three times. Use the back of a butter knife or spoon to ensure the bag is tightly sealed.3. Place the sealer firmly over the vacuum hole. Start the vacuum process and twist/wiggle the sealer a tiny bit to ensure a good seal. For added security, place a small piece of freezer tape over the hole.The manufacturer said these bags were "not recommended" for the freezer because they "might" not hold the seal. I tested this... THEY DO HOLD, if you seal them correctly. I make portions of meats and cheese for sandwiches, fruit, vegetables, and other items and wanted to be able to remove a portion and reseal the bag and return it to the freezer. These re-sealable bags are perfect for that.Remember though, for use in freezer or refrigerator, you must blanch vegetables before sealing. Especially broccoli which gives off gasses when sealed fresh, Read the manual ( I know, I usually don't either) but this manual has important information and no one wants to take a chance and either waste food or worse, get sick. To freeze fruits, wash, dry, peel, slice and freeze on cookie sheets first. Place in zipper bag then into the foodsaver bag. Take out what you need and reseal. For long term storage use the regular foodsaver bags or rolls.Obviously these are terrific for non freezer and non refrigerator storage too.  All your pantry items will stay fresh seemingly forever.Like me, you will wonder how you ever lived without this system and these bags.
